key.name: kill-switch
key.description:
Emergency key that stops wgaf from synthesizing any further keyboard or mouse input. It only ever stops: pressing it again will not restart automation, because during a runaway script you should be able to lean on it. Run `wgaf release` when you are ready to allow input again.
The default is Escape on its own — easy to reach, universally understood as cancel, and not something you would confuse with an automation command.
Note what a desktop-wide shortcut means for a key this ordinary: while the wgaf extension is enabled, Escape is taken by the emergency stop before any application sees it. If you need Escape back for everyday use, set this to a combination instead (Ctrl+Alt+Escape, say), or to an empty list to remove the shortcut entirely.
